nodes.name: Subir a Google Drive
nodes.notes: 1) Crea carpeta en Drive y pega su ID. 2) Credencial Google Drive. 3) Activa este nodo y conecta Read Binary si hace falta. Por defecto desactivado: el backup local + rotación funcionan igual.

parameters.command: =powershell -NoProfile -Command "$dir = '{{ $json.backupDir }}'; $days = {{ $json.daysToKeep }}; $limit = (Get-Date).AddDays(-1 * $days); $removed = @(); Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $dir -File -Filter 'backup_*.zip' | Where-Object { $_.LastWriteTime -lt $limit } | ForEach-Object { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $_.FullName -Force; $removed += $_.Name }; Write-Output (\"deleted=$($removed.Count); files=$($removed -join ',')\")"

parameters.subject: =💾 Backup OK — {{ $('Parsear ruta ZIP').item.json.fileName }}
